text:
nora (Partnerships): Quick sync: proposing a three-stage marketplace offer for HW+SI combos: Trial -> Growth -> Enterprise. Need input on discount depth, commit length, and announcement timing.
sam (Sales): Love the idea. do we risk displacing direct enterprise deals?
nora (Partnerships): We gate Trial with a low $10k 60-day commit, Growth is 12mo with true-up, Enterprise mirrors Dedicated contract. No new SKUs; use listing flags.
viv (Product): Key callout: any HW rebate redeemable only against Reserved/Dedicated capacity must map to capacity SKU ids. ops needs that mapping.
tara (Finance): Financial rules: onboarding credits are amortized over the committed term. Trial credits are smaller but paid up-front as contra-revenue. I'll model ARR impact.
ashok (Solutions): SI activation: require a 30-day checklist (integration test, demo, co-marketing blurb). SI credit activates after checklist pass. Credits do not stack.
legal-bot: Reminder: partner marketing LOA required 10 business days pre-announce; partner quote sign-off window is 3 business days.
ops (Eng): Ops checklist: sandbox pricing mask, entitlement flag, billing hook smoke test, and telemetry for credit redemptions. I can validate Wed AM.
sam (Sales): Discount suggestions: Trial 40% off list + $2k onboarding credit; Growth 22% off + $1k credit; Enterprise by-negotiation. For HW partners, propose 10% co-sell pool to fund rebates.
viv (Product): UI text: show "Intro price (Trial)" and "Expected renewal (Growth)" with tooltip explaining step-downs. Add FAQ link.
tara (Finance): Renewal ladder: if usage >=100% commit, reduce discount by 8ppt next year; otherwise maintain current discount. Also propose a retention kicker: >=110% -> extend Growth discount by 3ppt.
nora (Partnerships): Launch runbook idea: T-6w assets, T-4w LOA signed, T-3w SI enablement, T-1w legal signoff, public announce. Action owners: Nora finalize pricing doc (Tue), Tara ARR model (Thu), Ashok SI checklist (Fri), Ops validate sandbox (Wed). Any objections? :rocket:
